run_gtn_loss_example: run the pytorch loss example to compute sequence criterion loss with GTN graphs
create_target_graph: create a target graph from a token sequence where each token aligns to one or more frames
build_gtn_loss_function: build a custom PyTorch loss function using GTN graphs for frame-level to token-level sequence alignment
compute_forward_loss: compute the forward loss by scoring target graphs against emission graphs using forward score and subtraction
compute_backward_gradients: compute backward gradients for GTN loss by calling gtn backward and extracting gradient weights
